name: Tibolddaróc (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tibolddaróc: a red shield with a white bird and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a stag crest and red and blue mantling, above a scroll inscribed TIBOLDDARÓC.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
